title: Easy Air Fryer French Toast Sticks
description: These air fryer French toast sticks are easy to prep with slices of thick bread, milk, eggs, and cinnamon for a crispy golden breakfast treat.
ingredients: 4 slices slightly stale thick bread, such as Texas toast

steps.text: Cut each slice of bread into thirds to make sticks. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom of the air fryer basket.
Preheat air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C).

Stir together eggs, milk, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a bowl until well combined. Dip each piece of bread into egg mixture, making sure each piece is well submerged. Shake each bread stick to remove excess liquid and place in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding the fryer.
Cook for 5 minutes, turn bread pieces, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.

video.description: Skip the frozen goods aisle and make this bite-sized breakfast at home! In this video, Nicole shows you the easy way to make French toast sticks using an air fryer. Using either fresh or leftover stale bread, divide the slices into thin sticks. Dunk the French toast sticks in the egg mixture before placing in the air fryer to cook. Whether coated in a cinnamon-sugar coating or simply dunked in maple syrup, it’s a decadent and easy recipe for kids and adults!
